translationRepairs: Transported transferred Shan Dong grain, to supply central capital officials, year not over several ten thousand shi.
Shandong grain was transported by canal to supply the central government offices, no more than several hundred thousand shi per year.
Chinese 數十萬石 is several hundred thousand shi, not several ten thousand; the revised wording also removes the fused calque 'transported transferred.'
East to vast sea commandery, people troops expenses comparable to south barbarians.
In the east, the expedition to Canghai Commandery cost as much in manpower as the campaigns against the Southern Yi.
滄海之郡 is the proper name Canghai Commandery, not a descriptive 'vast sea' commandery; the full revision also makes 人徒之費 intelligible English.
At that point, Grand Farmer Chen’s reserves of money were already spent, the taxes were exhausted, and they still were not enough to support the soldiers.
By then, the Grand Farmer's cash reserves had been depleted and tax revenues exhausted, yet there was still not enough to support the soldiers.
大農陳藏錢 means the Grand Farmer office's stored money; 陳藏 is not a personal name Chen, so the original invented a person.
Ranks seventeen thousand, altogether worth thirty more ten thousand gold.
There were 170,000 ranks in all, worth more than 300,000 in gold.
Chinese 十七萬 is 170,000 ranks; the original literal omitted the 萬 scale and rendered 三十餘萬 ungrammatically.

From the time Gongsun Hong used the moral principles of the Spring and Autumn Annals to bind his subordinates and became Han chancellor, and Zhang Tang used crafty legal argument to reach the position of imperial counselor, public affairs came to rely heavily on documentation and technical legal reasoning.

After Gongsun Hong used the principles of the Spring and Autumn Annals to discipline his subordinates and attain the Han chancellorship, and Zhang Tang used severe legal arguments to decide cases and become Commandant of Justice, the law punishing officials who saw and knew of crimes without reporting them arose, and prosecutions for neglect, obstruction, disparagement, and slander were pursued exhaustively.

張湯…為廷尉 is Commandant of Justice, not imperial counselor; the sentence also expressly introduces the seeing-and-knowing law and exhaustive prosecutions for 廢格沮誹, which the original replaced with an invented documentation summary.
The laws became increasingly strict, and many clerks were abolished and exempted.
The laws grew increasingly severe, and many officials were dismissed from office.
吏多廢免 means many officials were removed or cashiered; 'abolished and exempted' confuses dismissal with the exemption purchases in the next sentence.
Zheng Dang Shi because Wei transport canal circuitous far, chiseled straight canal from Chang An to Hua Yin, workers several ten thousand;
Because the Wei transport canal made a long detour, Zheng Dangshi dug a direct canal from Chang'an to Huayin, employing tens of thousands of workers;
鄭當時, 長安, and 華陰 are single proper nouns; the full revision also turns the remaining word-for-word calques into grammatical English.
Xian Yang, Qi great boiled salt, Kong Jin, Nan Yang great smelter, all brought living accumulated thousand gold, therefore Zheng Dang Shi advanced spoke them.
Xianyang was a major salt producer from Qi, and Kong Jin a major iron smelter from Nanyang; both had amassed fortunes of several thousand in gold, so Zheng Dangshi recommended them.
The names must be joined, and 致生累千金 means that both men had amassed substantial fortunes; 'productive wealth amounting to a thousand gold' remained awkward and understated 累千.

Henan submitted a register of wealthy men who had aided the poor. When the Son of Heaven saw Bu Shi’s name, he recognized him and said, “This is the man who earlier wished to contribute half his property to aid the frontier.”

Henan submitted a register of wealthy men who had aided the poor. When the Son of Heaven saw Bu Shi's name, he recognized him and said, “This is the man who earlier wished to contribute half his property to aid the frontier,” and granted Shi the commutation payments for four hundred men's frontier service.
The original omitted 乃賜式外繇四百人. In context, 外繇 denotes frontier service and its commutation payment, which Shi could then return to the government in the following sentence.
The emperor considered Shi remarkable, appointed him magistrate of Gou as a trial, and Gou found him effective.
The emperor considered Shi remarkable and, to test him, appointed him magistrate of Goushi, whose people found his administration beneficial.
緱氏 is the county name Goushi, not Gou, and 緱氏便之 means that the people there benefited from or approved of his administration.
He was moved and appointed as magistrate of Chenggao, and led transport the best.
He was transferred to serve as magistrate of Chenggao, where his supervision of grain transport received the highest rating.
將漕最 means his management of grain transport was rated foremost; 'led transport the best' is ungrammatical.

Traveling west, the imperial party crossed Long. The governor of Longxi accompanied the journey with troops, but the Son of Heaven’s attendants could not obtain food, and the governor was convicted and killed.

Traveling west, the imperial party crossed Long. The governor of Longxi was caught unprepared by the tour's sudden arrival; the Son of Heaven's attendants had no food, and the governor committed suicide.
以行往卒 means the imperial progress arrived suddenly, and 隴西守自殺 means the governor committed suicide; the original invented a troop escort and judicial execution.

And imperial censor Zhang Tang just exalted noble used affairs, appointed Xuan, Du Zhou etc. as assistant censors, Yi Zong, Yin Qi, Wang Wen Shu etc. used cruel urgent harsh deep as nine ministers, and direct finger Xia Lan kind began came out.

At this time, Censor-in-Chief Zhang Tang was at the height of his influence. Jian Xuan, Du Zhou, and others became assistant censors; Yi Zong, Yin Qi, Wang Wenshu, and others rose to the Nine Ministers through cruel, harsh, and exacting methods; and special commissioners such as Xia Lan began to be sent out.
The literal dropped the surname 減 from Jian Xuan and split Wang Wenshu's name; the full revision also removes opaque calques such as 'direct finger.'
Yet the counties through which the troops passed merely supplied enough wealth to meet immediate needs; they did not dare mention the laws against unauthorized taxation.
Yet the counties through which the troops passed merely drew on their own resources to prevent shortages, and no one dared call this unauthorized taxation.
不敢言擅賦法 means that these emergency exactions went unchallenged as unauthorized taxation; 'the laws against unauthorized taxation' leaves the relation unclear.

Hong Yang with various officials each self purchased, mutually contended, goods therefore leaped jumped, and world taxes transports or not repaid their hired expenses, then requested established great farmer division assistants several ten people, divided sections mastered commanderies kingdoms, each often county established equal transport salt iron officials, ordered distant places each with their goods expensive time merchants transferred sold ones as taxes, and mutually irrigated input.

Hongyang observed that because the various offices each made their own purchases, they competed with one another and drove prices sharply upward, while taxes shipped from across the empire sometimes did not cover their freight costs. He therefore requested the appointment of several dozen regional assistants to the Grand Farmer, each responsible for a group of commanderies and kingdoms. Equal-transport and salt-and-iron offices were established in selected counties, and distant regions were ordered to pay their taxes in local goods of the kinds merchants normally transported for sale when prices were high, so that goods could be transferred and supplied among the regions.
相灌輸 means redistributing and supplying goods among regions, not irrigation; the original literal was also too calqued to convey the equal-transport policy accurately.
What it came from was long and distant, and from before the Gaoxin clan it still was, but it could not be recorded.
Its origins lay in the remote past, even before the age of Gaoxin, and cannot be recorded.
尚矣 marks remote antiquity before Gaoxin; the original was ungrammatical and missed the historical sense.
Wei employed Li Ke, fully used the land's productive strength, and became a powerful state.
Wei employed Li Ke, fully developed the productive capacity of its land, and became powerful.
Wei is the sentence's polity-level subject. 為彊君 says that, under Li Ke's policies, Wei became a powerful ruling state; changing the predicate to 'became a strong ruler' would wrongly personify Wei.
Therefore, externally repelled barbarian barbarians, internally aroused merit works, within seas scholars strength farmed insufficient grain food, women spun wove insufficient clothes.

Thus, abroad they repelled the Yi and Di, and at home they launched great undertakings; yet the men of the realm could not produce enough provisions however hard they farmed, nor could its women weave enough cloth for clothing.
夷狄 are the Yi and Di, not 'barbarian barbarians,' and 海內之士 here are the realm's men rather than scholars; the full revision also removes the remaining unreadable calques.
